findings.title: meta_description_duplicate: Duplicate meta description (13 URLs)
findings.reason: Las 12 variantes son filtros con canonical `/jobs`. No crear descripciones distintas solo para eliminar la alerta.

findings.title: title_duplicate: Duplicate title (13 URLs)

findings.title: duplicate_content: Duplicate content (13 URLs)
